title: Finite-coefficient exceptional adjunction and coefficient mates over an arbitrary field
statement:
Let $k$ be a field of positive characteristic $p$, let $\ell\ne p$ be prime, and let $f:X\to Y$ be a $k$-morphism of separated finite-type $k$-schemes [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions]. Fix a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$, its valuation ring $R$ and uniformizer $t$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. Write $A_n=R/t^n$ for $n\geq1$. For a finite coefficient ring $A$ occurring below, let $D^b_{ctf}(T,A)$ mean the full stable enhanced subcategory of the derived category of $A_T$-module sheaves with bounded constructible cohomology and finite Tor amplitude, admitting etale-origin witnesses on $T_{\mathrm{proet}}$ [def-weil-proetale-tor-amplitude, def-weil-proetale-constructible-sheaf, def-weil-pbc-etale-origin-witness, lem-coef-semilinear-derived-sections]. Choose a compactification $c=(X\xrightarrow{j}\overline X\xrightarrow{g}Y)$ [def-weil-compactifications-refinements], and put $F_A=Rg_{*,A}j_!$ [def-compact-support-direct-image-detailed]. For $T=X,Y$, let $\nu_T:T_{\mathrm{proet}}\to T_{\mathrm{et}}$ be the site comparison [def-weil-pbc-site-comparison-morphism]. Let $f_A^\times$ be the ordinary etale right adjoint of $Rg_{\mathrm{et},*,A}j_{\mathrm{et},!}$ [thm-amb-etale-exceptional-adjoint], with its unit and counit. On the etale-origin finite constructible subcategory define
$$G_A=Rf_A^!=\nu_X^* f_A^\times R\nu_{Y,*}.$$
The adjunction on this subcategory is transported using the site-comparison unit and the compact-support comparison [thm-weil-pbc-site-comparison, lem-sf-class-compact-support-comparison]. This construction is made for the arbitrary field $k$ just specified.

The functors $F_A,G_A$ preserve these finite-Tor constructible categories and $F_A\dashv G_A$ there, with the geometric finite-coefficient units $\eta_A$ and counits $\epsilon_A$. Consider either a quotient $A_m\to A_n$, $m\ge n$, or the finite-free map $R/t^n\to S/t^nS$ for a finite extension $E\subset F$ with valuation ring $S=\mathcal O_F$. Put $T_X=-\otimes_A^L B_X$ and $T_Y=-\otimes_A^L B_Y$ for the corresponding coefficient extensions. The canonical projection comparison
$$q_{A,B}:T_YF_A\xrightarrow{\sim}F_BT_X$$
is an equivalence of enhanced functors on $D^b_{ctf}(X,A)$. Its right-adjoint mate
$$b_{A,B}:T_XG_A\xrightarrow{\sim}G_BT_Y$$
is an equivalence on $D^b_{ctf}(Y,A)$. Specifically, $b_{A,B}$ is the $F_B\dashv G_B$ transpose of $T_Y\epsilon_A\circ q_{A,B,G_A}^{-1}$; consequently
$$\epsilon_B\circ F_B(b_{A,B})=T_Y\epsilon_A\circ q_{A,B,G_A}^{-1}.$$
For $K\in D^b_{ctf}(X,A)$ the unit identity is
$$G_B(q_{A,B,K})\circ b_{A,B,F_AK}\circ T_X(\eta_{A,K})=\eta_{B,T_XK}.$$ The geometric models for $F_A$ and the maps $q$ are the enhanced open-extension/proper-direct-image models of [lem-coef-semilinear-derived-sections]; their tensor associativity, identity, coefficient-composition and compactification-refinement diagrams are coherent. The mates $b$ have the same identities and coherences. These assertions also hold for the mixed diagrams obtained by composing the displayed coefficient maps. Thus extension from $R$ to $S$ compares the whole exceptional coefficient system, including its counit, on the cofinal quotients $S/t^nS$; these are the subsequence $S/v^{en}$ for a uniformizer $v$ of $S$ and ramification index $e$. No integral inverse-limit adjunction, rational or condensed comparison is asserted.
